author: BoldAndBrash
body:
So recently my brother told me about a gamemode he thought would play well on AVN called Titan. He got this idea from Planetside 2 and Star Wars Battlefront 2. Basically, there are 2 teams who have hold control points. The control points start out as white wool. After a player from lets say red team stays in the control point for 20 seconds, it will be captured for the team and turn red. Let's say 1 control point is 5x5. The player would have to stand in the 5x5 area for 20 seconds to capture the point. If he was on blue team, the white wool will turn blue. Also, when a person is capturing the point, an anvil noise will be heard by all players. It will also say in chat that the point is/has been captured. Please note that you can NOT place blocks in this game.
Now let's go more in depth.
Kits: http://avicus.net/forums/6d61f650d
About
     There are 2 teams in this game who pvp over an uneven amount of control points. After around 15 minutes, the team with the most points under their control wins. This idea was inspired by Star Wars Battlefront 2 and Planet Side 2. That's basically it.

Control Points
     The control points are 5x5 squares with a white wool block on top of a fence in the middle.They are usually located in buildings or easy to spot places. To capture the point, the player must stand in the designated area for 20 seconds. After the 20 seconds, the white wool will become the color of the player who captured it. For example, if the player was on blue team, the white wool would turn blue. If there is an enemy in the area with you, the control point will NOT capture. You must kill the player in order for it to begin. Capture points are the main part of this game that make it different from the rest.

Credits
In this game, in order to earn credits. you must capture points, gain kills, and win games. Capture points are the best sources for credits. for they give the most amount. Racking up kills is the second best way to earn credits.

Capturing = 10 exp. points.

Titan Points Shop
3 points = 1 golden apple
3 points = Yellow dye that gives nausea 3 for 2 seconds (PROJECTILE)
4 points = Inc Sack that gives blindness 1 for 4 seconds (PROJECTILE)
4 points = Lime dye that gives poison 1 for 4 seconds (PROJECTILE)
4 points = Boom Grenade (iron) that KB's anyone in a 3x3 area, no dmg. (PROJECTILE) 
5 points = 2 golden apples
5 points = Bone Meal does 2 hearts of damage when thrown (PROJECTILE)
5 points = Stun Grenade (gold) does slowness and blindness for 3 seconds (PROJECTILE)
6 points = Shrapnel Grenade is a netherbrick throws 5 bonemeals in a star form (PROJECTILE)
7 points =  Land Mine is a stone plate that does 3 hearts of damage, it is breakable by enemies
7 points = Fire Dust gives fire aspect 1 for 6 seconds to whoever it hits (PROJECTILE)
8 points = 3 golden apples
8 points = Fart is a bow with 3 uses & gives nausea 2 and blindness 1 for 5 seconds and it releases a smoke once it hits someone (PROJECTILE)
9 points = The Peaceful Protest is a sign that has sharpness 2 and has a 25% of giving a player nausea
10 points = I Promise It's Not A Flamethrower is a bow that comes along with 10 arrows and the bow has the enchantment fire aspect 2 (PROJECTILE)

We will make a separate post for the kits due to it being waaaayyy too long. We'll post the link to it on this thread. I hope you guys like this idea and constructive feedback would be appreciated.
